Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
This is the third thread of the discussions about cards some people see as problematic.

As this is a collection of arguments for keeping the card as it is (PRO card) or changing it in whatever way (CONTRA card).

It would be most useful, if you could write above your entry, if your arguments are PRO or CONTRA the card as it is to attain best clarity of what speaks in favor of the card and what does not.

After 7 days of discussion I will initialize a poll about that specific card, in which the alternatives can be found.

Lilith's Blessing
Master
[1 Pool]
Master.
Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card to search your library for a master: Discipline card and choose a ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.

PRO
I think this card is only a problem because the trifelness of Villein. Without that it is rather difficult to be on zero blood in a master phase without a Vessel on you. The effect is very good indeed, but not broken or damaging the game. So I'd leave it as it is, if Villein was changed.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
PRO

It costs 1 pool, the effect is nice but hard to trigger (if you don't play Villein), and it costs a MPA.

Even when abused with Villein, it's not overpowered: it leaves your vampire at 3 blood, ready to be rushed.

I tried to put some in my Aim & Chain, it was an utter failure. The MPA cost is too much and the "once per vampire" too restrictive when you really need blood. I'd rather play some Hunting Grounds, Jake Washington or Life in the City in such decks.

I'd quite nice in my Huitzilopochtli - Great Beast on the other hand, but good cards useful in certain decks are good things.

Also, I've not seem the card played that often, I'm not sure what people are complaining about.

Messages.Author: PetriWessman
Messages.Body:
PRO (assuming something is done about Villein to stop the Villein + Lilith combo)

CONTRA (if Villein stays as is)

It's a good card, but only Villein really makes it broken. Without that, it's still good but not an automatic bloat machine. I don't see it as a problem if Villein is seriously nerfed (taking away the Trifle would be my favorite).

If Villein stays, then this card needs a fix. Making it Unique would be the best way to do that, imho. Of course, that would make the game a somewhat silly race to see who gets to play it first... but hey, it's *already* a silly race to see who gets the Villein + Giant's Blood first... :/

I *would* love to see some new cards that do something (possibly nasty) with that Bahari keyword, but that's another matter

Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:
Team
I've written elsewhere that I think this card is ok for the following reasons:
-You have more then 2 on your deck: better chance of having it, deck is worse.
-You have 1 or 2 on your deck: less chance of using it, but the deck is more focused.
-This card trades winning pool for making your deck more vulnerable to combat. And with just 3 blood, it makes your vampires able to use less cards that cost blood.
-Villein is the bigger issue, but if you touch Villein you open a bigger can of worms (see appropriate thread for Villein related issues).

Messages.Author: wastaz
Messages.Body:
> extrala wrote:
> 2.b. Forcing a discipline card to be fetched (similar to The Becoming). (Actually this is not my idea, but another German player (Sebastian?) suggested this this week to me).
>
I really like this idea. It's really quite interesting.
However, I am

PRO
* The real problem is villein. Getting a vampire to 0 blood in the master phase is hard to do reliably without it.
* It already costs 1 MPA to put Liliths into play, and another MPA each time you want to use it. I've never seen this card as a problem because often enough choosing between using liliths and playing an actual master card is just so damn hard when I'm actually in the game.
* To use it reliably you have to fill your deck with them, playing just 1 liliths in a deck of 90 is just asking for not seeing it during your entire game.

Of course, the multiple-master-action craze that is going on right now is making liliths a better card than otherwise. Heck, with Nana or Anson out you could potentially even use minion tap to do the villein-liliths combo if you wanted
Though I still feel that the main problem is villein and its trifleness. With Anson out I could potentially do Minion Tap+Lilith on one of my vampires. But that would be it. With Anson out and villein I could do Villein+Lilith+Another cool master, which is much better.

If the proposed fixes to villein (limit the blood it takes for instance) is done, I don't see that Liliths should be a huge problem (except for decks that only bloat, but if you want to make a bloat-only deck then go ahead, more power to you).

I´m not really for errata nor banning. I´ve tried the card in several decks and find that if you use alot of them without having extra MPAs, you don´t get to play many other funny masters. With extra MPAs it´s another thing, but that´s a whole other problem - the extra MPA-decks are too strong in general and needs some good hosing.

Suggested master-hosing card:
Methuselah´s Thirst
Event
The first non-out of turn master played in each master phase cost 1 additional pool. Each subsequent non-out of turn master played cost 2 additional pool.
(This card also speeds up games = good. Alternatively, it could be first master = 0 additional pool, each subsequent = 2 additional pool.)

Suggested Bahari-hoser:
Give pain to seekers
Unique master
Tap this card during your minion phase and choose a vampire. Once until your next untap phase, the chosen vampire may burn 1 blood to enter combat with any minion as a  action. If the minion is Bahari, this action is at +1 stealth. Any vampire can steal this card as a  action.
(Note: Might need some more restrictions. But you get the idea.)

Another suggested Bahari-hoser:
Lilith´s Damnation
Master
Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card choose a ready non-Bahari vampire. That vampire burns one blood and becomes Bahari.

(Note: If any Bahari-hosing cards are harsh, it also opens up for good cards playable by Bahari.)

If you absolutely want to errata the Blessing, I suggest forcing the adding of a skill card (as per The Becoming).
